title: GLG Releases 'Navigating Trade and Tariffs' eBook with Expert Insights
summary: GLG published a comprehensive eBook on navigating the evolving trade and tariff landscape, featuring actionable recommendations from APAC exporters and U.S. importers. The report includes perspectives from senior decision-makers across industries on adapting to trade policy shifts.
whyItMatters: GLG leverages its expert network for timely policy analysis, showcasing the value of expert insights for strategic decisions.
